description: This file defines the Utils class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, providing utility functions for promise handling such as queue management, promise inspection, waiting, and combinators like all, some, any, and settle.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing promise queues, creating promises, inspecting, waiting, and combining multiple promises.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Gets or sets the global task queue used for promise resolution.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Adds a task to the queue and returns a promise that resolves or rejects based on task execution.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Synchronously inspects a promise, returning its state and value or reason.

methods.name: inspectAll
methods.description: Inspects multiple promises, returning an array of their states.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Waits on multiple promises and returns their fulfilled values, throwing on rejection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when all input promises are fulfilled, or rejects if any reject.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when a specified number of promises are fulfilled, or rejects if not enough fulfill.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with the first fulfilled promise's value.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with an array of states of all input promises, regardless of rejection or fulfillment.
